title: I-0006 git-author audit (no hardcoded names)
body_md: I-0006 says commit author is whatever git config user.name/user.email resolve to — no hardcoded usernames. Add bin/lint-no-hardcoded-author.sh that greps src/ bin/ for literal patterns like 'a-canary' / 'aaron' / 'anthropic.com' / 'noreply' embedded in commit/author logic (allowed in comments + tests as fixtures). Wire into merge-gate.
acceptance_md: lint script exits 0 on clean tree; exits 1 if a hardcoded literal author surfaces in non-test source; merge-gate invokes it.
evidence_md: Added bin/lint-no-hardcoded-author.sh as Gate 4 in merge-gate.sh; clean tree PASS, planted offender FAIL; commit 2a06d83 PR #29
